sources.title: Llama 3.3 official model card
sources.evidence: Exact 70B Instruct model: Meta developer, nominal 70B, autoregressive Transformer, GQA, multilingual text input/output, 128k context, December 6 2024 release, custom license, and code/tool-use evaluations.

sources.title: Llama 3.3 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Names the Llama 3.3 Community License and December 6 2024 version release date. Grants licensed access and use of trained weights, with attribution, acceptable-use and additional commercial terms.

sources.title: Meta model identifiers and context limits
sources.evidence: Maps llama3_3_70b_instruct to the llama3_3 family and explicitly returns maximum sequence length 131072 for that family.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct architecture registration
sources.evidence: Exact llama3_3_instruct_models registration names the official Hub repository and supplies dimension 8192, 80 layers, 64 query heads, 8 KV heads and ordinary feedforward architecture arguments.

sources.title: Meta Llama Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: The implementation matching the registered architecture executes causal attention and a three-projection SiLU-gated feedforward in each Transformer block; there is no expert routing. Used with exact 3.3 architecture registration, not as a source of earlier-release specifications.

sources.title: Llama 3.3 prompt and tool-calling formats
sources.evidence: Exact 3.3 Instruct instructions document native built-in and zero-shot custom function calls, tool-return messages and control tokens. No dedicated thinking-mode interface is specified.

sources.title: Llama 3.3 developer documentation
sources.evidence: Clarifies that the 70B text-only model is available only as Instruct. Explicitly documents multiple/parallel function-call generation and built-in Brave Search, Wolfram Alpha and code interpreter calls, which require an external executor.

sources.title: Official Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct weight repository
sources.evidence: Exact model name and official downloadable weight repository under the Llama 3.3 community license. Weights require accepting access terms; public card is accessible.

sources.title: Llama models repository overview
sources.evidence: Lists Llama 3.3 under the Llama family and describes licensed weight downloads. Overview table gives December 4 2024, conflicting with the exact model card and license, both December 6.

sources.title: Later Llama 4 card comparison with Llama 3.3
sources.evidence: Exact Llama 3.3 70B comparison column confirms no multimodal support and 128K context. It does not separately disclose active parameters for Llama 3.3; the activated/total figures belong to Llama 4.

sources.title: Official checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. No attempt was made to bypass the access gate or download model weights.

name.note: Canonical identifier of the exact official Instruct checkpoint.

family.note: Llama 3.3 is a member of the Llama family; preserve the catalog family key.

release_date.note: Exact model card and versioned license both say December 6. Prefer these model-specific release declarations over the overview table's conflicting December 4.

open_weights.note: Trained weights are offered for download under a custom license and access agreement. Open weights does not imply an unrestricted open-source license.

license.note: Use the model-specific custom commercial license, including its incorporated acceptable-use policy.

parameters_b.note: Meta explicitly reports 70B; this is the published nominal count, not an independently reconciled exact learned-parameter count. No HF aggregate or earlier-model count is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-per-token count is disclosed for this exact model in inspected first-party specifications or the later comparison card. Dense structure does not justify copying the total.

architecture.note: Dense causal Transformer with GQA: exact 3.3 registration specifies 80 layers, width 8192 and 64 query/8 KV heads. Matching Meta Transformer blocks use ordinary feedforward projections without expert routing.

context_window.note: Meta's exact llama3_3 family dispatch resolves the card's 128k to 131072 tokens; correct the decimal 128000 baseline.

modalities.note: Text-only multilingual input/output; generated code is text. Later comparison explicitly states no multimodal support.

reasoning.note: General reasoning/CoT benchmark results do not disclose a dedicated thinking mode. The inspected model card and native prompt documentation do not separately establish that capability or its absence; clear baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact 3.3 docs explicitly support custom zero-shot and built-in tool calls, including multiple/parallel generated calls; execution is external.

description.value: Meta's 70B instruction-tuned Llama 3.3 model for multilingual text chat, code generation and tool calling.
description.note: Replace subjective popular/workhorse wording with documented multilingual chat, code generation and tool-calling capabilities.

patch.description: Meta's 70B instruction-tuned Llama 3.3 model for multilingual text chat, code generation and tool calling.

sources.label: Meta model identifiers and context limits

patch.notes: Meta publishes a nominal 70B total; active parameters are not separately disclosed. Dense Transformer with GQA; context is 131072 tokens. Native custom and built-in tool calling are documented, while dedicated reasoning-mode support is undisclosed. Exact card and license date release to December 6, 2024; the repository overview conflicts with December 4. Gated checkpoint configuration was not accessed; no exact tensor count is claimed.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Confirm nominal 70B using primary evidence; add the Llama 3.3 license and dense GQA architecture; correct context from 128000 to 131072; clear unsupported reasoning=false and replace subjective description. Preserve exact-model December 6 release and native tool calling. Active count and dedicated thinking mode remain undisclosed. Record overview date conflict and gated configuration limitation without gate bypass or weight downloads.
